_file: Benchmark mode: embed, apply each attack, measure what survives and what it cost. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored. Check with --validate-only; reset with 'deepmark-benchmark --init benchmark'.
_general: Operational settings; the matching CLI flag overrides each one. wav_files_dir has no default - set it here or pass --wav_files_dir. report_dir is DELETED at the start of every run. seed: integer for a repeatable run, or null for a fresh watermark per file.
_models: Model class names; two or more adds a comparative report. Any of: AudioSealModel, AwareModel, PerthModel, SilentCipherModel, TimbreWMModel, WavMarkModel. Each one's Docker service must be running.
_attacks: groups and list are combined; leaving BOTH empty runs every attack. groups - any of: process_disruption, audio_editing, audio_distortion, desynchronization, ai_attacks, transmission. list - attack class names, optionally AttackName:version (e.g. GaussianNoiseAttack:aggressive).
_attack_parameters: Plugin parameter overrides, keyed by attack CLASS NAME (its default version ONLY) or AttackName:version; naming a version the plugin lacks DEFINES it when you give ALL of that attack's parameters. Delete the underscore from an entry below to activate it.
_calculate_quality_metrics: Master switch: true = the metrics block below decides what runs; false or absent = only accuracy plus pesq, visqol, stoi, and the enabled flags are IGNORED (statistics still apply).
_statistics: Default statistics per metric, and the report column order. Any of: mean, std, median, p5, p10, p95, p99, worst_case. Delete this key to get all eight.
_metrics: Per metric: enabled (true/false) and statistics (a subset of the list above). Metrics - accuracy (always on, cannot be disabled), ber, emr (a count, takes NO statistics), pesq, psnr, si_sdr, mcd, visqol, stoi, sii, ncm, nisqa_mos, nisqa_noi, nisqa_dis, nisqa_col, nisqa_loud. A metric named nowhere is off.

metrics._defaults: Baseline for every group. The signal metrics are OFF here and each group below switches on the ones that are meaningful for it, so a group section reads as a positive list of what it reports. accuracy/ber/emr are free (all three come from the accuracy array) and apply everywhere.
metrics._per_group: Each group lists the metrics it reports, as true. Inheritance is PER METRIC, so a group inherits anything it does not name from defaults above - where the signal metrics are off, which is why each section is a complete list. Group keys: the six attack families, then frequency_filtering / temporal_editing / audio_effects / compression_quantization (report subsections of audio_editing, NOT selectable in attacks.groups), then other. A group this run does not use is ignored; a MISSPELLED one is an error.

per_group._process_disruption: Collusion and re-watermarking keep the signal intact, so every metric applies.
per_group._audio_editing: The family as a whole. Its four subsections below are read INSTEAD of this in the detailed report, and each states its own full list because it inherits from here.
per_group._audio_distortion: Additive noise. No mcd: index-aligned, and it adds nothing PESQ and ViSQOL do not already say.
per_group._desynchronization: The time axis moves. pesq, visqol and stoi are on, as in every family, with mcd and the reference-free NISQA; psnr, si_sdr, sii and ncm are off. stoi and mcd compare samples by index, so reports mark them with a dagger and a footnote: here they measure the shift, not quality.
per_group._ai_attacks: Neural resynthesis rewrites the waveform, so psnr and si_sdr collapse while perceptual quality holds.
per_group._transmission: Replay and network loss keep sample alignment, so every metric applies.
per_group._frequency_filtering: audio_editing subsection: lowpass, highpass, bandstop, equalizer. psnr/si_sdr off.
per_group._temporal_editing: audio_editing subsection: cut, crop-beginning, crop-random. Signal length changes, so nothing can be compared to the original; accuracy, ber and emr still are.
per_group._audio_effects: audio_editing subsection: wavelet, smoothing, chorus, flanger, echo, mixing. psnr off.
per_group._compression_quantization: audio_editing subsection: quantization, MP3, Encodec, DAC, Opus, Codec2, resampling. si_sdr off.
per_group._other: Attacks in no declared family, including third-party plugins. Everything on, since nothing is known to be misleading.

_comparison: Used only with two or more models. primary_statistic is the one ranked in the main comparison table; it must be one of accuracy's statistics. Every other one gets its own table below it.
_crop_before_attack: Percentage cropped from the START of the watermarked audio before each attack, to test a watermark that cannot rely on being aligned. A number greater than 0 and less than 100, or null to disable.
_efficiency: What the run cost in time and memory, kept apart from the metrics block above. Those describe the watermarking method and reproduce from a seed; these describe this machine on this day and do not. enabled: false means none of it is measured. Metrics - embed_latency, detect_latency, attack_latency (seconds), container_footprint (MiB).
_efficiency_caveat: A native attack is timed as pure computation; one running in Docker includes base64 encoding of the audio and the HTTP round trip, so the two are not comparable. The first call to a cold container also pays for loading the model.

metrics._container_footprint: Resident memory of the model's container while warm, in MiB, read once per run via the docker CLI. It is the WHOLE service - weights, Python runtime, web server - not the size of the model, and the services load their weights at start so a container can never be measured empty. Absent, and simply omitted, when docker is unavailable or no container publishes the model's port.

_duration_groups: Report separately per audio length. boundaries: ascending seconds, e.g. [5, 10, 20, 30] gives <5s, 5-10s, 10-20s, 20-30s, >30s; an empty list disables grouping. include_overall adds a final all-files section.
